## Agenda Items


## 1. Budget Presentations
Throughout the month of June, the City Council will be discussing the City Manager's proposed budget line-by-line. This is a chance for the City Council to see where the City Manager wants to spend money. This meeting is a return to the school budget; at the last presentation the city council did not accept what was presented. 

This meeting will cover the following: 

 - School (round 2)
